'''December 2004 Fallston tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held on Saturday 4 December 2004 at Renaissance Games in Fallston, Maryland, organized by [[Tim Simon]]. It was billed as the first tournament after [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court|Virtual Set 8]] became legal.<ref name="pcf-4138-56911">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=56911#56911 Two MD Locals back to back!], Tim Simon, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 November 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050217013656/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=56911%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]]<ref name="pcf-4138-56911" />
* '''Site:''' Renaissance Games, Fallston, Maryland<ref name="pcf-4138-56911" />
* '''Dates:''' 4 December 2004, 12:30 pm<ref name="pcf-4138-56911" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Tim Simon]]<ref name="pcf-4138-56911" />

Simon announced it together with a local tournament at the Severna Park Community Center on Saturday 27 November 2004.<ref name="pcf-4138-56911" />
